meta.doctrine: shrink-only ratchet: entries and ids may only be REMOVED (in the same change that resolves them — a maintainer pin/range bump or an upstream fix absorbed by a floor reset). A new pair or a new advisory id is drift; the baseline may never grow. Escalation routing: findings on a pinned/range pin are maintainer bump decisions — this guard never edits requirements files.
